0022600217.text: The Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, losers of two straight) are 12th in the East and 4.5 games back in third in the Central, and they host the Wizards (4-7, 10th in the East), who have lost four straight and are 3-7 over their last ten while sitting 2.5 games back in fourth in the Southeast. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (out, hamstring strain; 21.8 points and 33.0 minutes per game this season), Ben Sheppard (out, knee), Johnny Furphy (out, knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (day-to-day, hamstring, a game-time decision), while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (out, foot), Reece Beekman (out, shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost 1-3, including a 131-118 loss in Washington on February 20.
